narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>In the first sum, I end up with ten lotuses. I will leave ten lotuses.
<bookmark mark='flash'/>Ten of any symbol can always be swapped for one of the next.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The lotuses must be swapped too, so the answer is not finished.
